verdict.rationale: Adyen's own MCP server explicitly lets users 'use natural language with your chosen LLM client'. It exposes tools for Checkout sessions, payment links, refunds and cancellations, plus Management API tasks such as terminals, webhooks and credentials. However, it is labelled Alpha, runs locally, requires a third-party LLM client and covers only a subset of the APIs. missing for 10: non-alpha/GA status, a native natural-language interface in the product itself (e.g. Customer Area), broader API coverage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
contains a set of tools that lets you interact with the Adyen APIs for common use cases
